### All Dressed Up - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/all-dressed-up-one-year-devotions-for-men-june-20.html
Passage: Exodus 28:1-2
Points:
- Aaron's sacred garments visually marked his separation unto God and mirrored the grandeur of the Lord he served.
- The priestly attire imparted public dignity and clear identity to the high priest's representative role.
- Bearing the tribal stones over Aaron's heart reminded him to carry the people's needs into God's holy presence.
- Believers in Christ today represent Him through godly conduct and intercede regularly for those in need.

### The Church Adorned with Beauty
Author: R.C. Sproul
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/church-adorned-beauty
Passage: Exodus 28:2
Points:
- God commanded holy vestments for Aaron that were created for glory and beauty, not mere utility.
- Scripture reveals that the Lord values beauty alongside goodness and truth, with His character as the ultimate standard.
- Christians often settle for purely functional approaches in ministry while neglecting aesthetic excellence.
- The worship and corporate life of the church should reflect tasteful beauty as an expression of honoring God.
